text.card: A star about 130 parsecs away, 4.8 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 4.8 solar radii and 1.95 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,322 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: HD 82886
quotes.card: HD 82886, also named Illyrian, is a star with an orbiting exoplanet located in the constellation Leo Minor.
quotes.introduction: It has an apparent visual magnitude of 7.63, making it too faint to be viewed with the naked eye.
